words.example: She spent her childhood in a mountain village.

example_translations.ru: Она провела детство в горной деревне.

words.example: As a teenager, Tom played guitar in a band.

example_translations.ru: Подростком Том играл на гитаре в группе.

words.example: Children must visit the pool with an adult.

example_translations.ru: Дети должны посещать бассейн со взрослым.
example_translations.uz: Bolalar hovuzga katta yoshli odam bilan borishi kerak.

words.example: In his youth, my grandfather was a good runner.

example_translations.ru: В молодости мой дедушка хорошо бегал.

words.example: Our generation grew up with the internet.

example_translations.uz: Bizning avlod internet bilan katta bo'ldi.

words.example: The birth of their son made them happy.
After his death, the writer became very famous.

example_translations.ru: После смерти писатель стал очень знаменитым.
example_translations.uz: O'limidan keyin yozuvchi juda mashhur bo'ldi.

words.example: Aziz often helps his elderly neighbor with shopping.

example_translations.ru: Азиз часто помогает пожилому соседу с покупками.
example_translations.uz: Aziz ko'pincha keksa qo'shnisiga xarid qilishda yordam beradi.

words.example: Malika is only sixteen, but she is very mature.

example_translations.ru: Малике всего шестнадцать, но она очень зрелая.
example_translations.uz: Malika endigina o'n olti yoshda, lekin u juda yetuk.

words.example: Seniors pay less for tickets at this museum.

example_translations.ru: Пожилые люди платят за билеты в этом музее меньше.
example_translations.uz: Keksa kishilar bu muzeyda chiptaga kamroq to'laydi.
